scope: Direct source assessment under established epoch-1 performance and honesty rules; not a Qwen/Gemma provider verdict or operator approval.

findings.reproducibility: supported at source and retained-evidence level; not independently rerun
findings.source_safety: supported with a nonblocking correctness advisory
findings.production_benefit: supported by real production paths and concrete mechanisms, not a claim of universal improvement
findings.preserved_advisory: Hot-lowering the framed write limit after scratch growth does not immediately enforce the smaller coalescing bound. The current production call sets 20 KiB once before writing; no failure at that callsite was found.
findings.preserved_tradeoffs: 256 KiB lead in-flight cap and temporary 2 KiB bulk yielding may hurt some workloads. These are genuine generic QoS tradeoffs, not new retrospective disqualification thresholds.
